description: Second-ARCHITECTURE replication arm for the flagship negative: CIFAR-10/resnet18, krum under Mode S (statistic-only, adversary pinned at c=1). Architecture varies alone against the frozen cifar_cnn arm. Rules frozen at 89046f6 (experiments/pre_registration_dose_resnet18.md).

config.endpoint_only_reason: resnet18 costs 1.63-1.72 h/run at this regime; two rungs x 3 seeds is ~10 h. A two-rung ladder has no trend to test and is never displayed as four.

arm.predicted_outcome: FLAT if the CIFAR-10/cifar_cnn negative is a property of the mechanism; RISING if it was specific to the shallow-CNN family

femnist_comparison.note: EMNIST-byclass/simple_cnn: a second dataset and a differently configured CNN, not a second family

standalone_krum_resnet18_prior_note: No artifact in results/ contains both resnet18 and krum, so this arm has no independent published figure to cross-check its kappa=0 rung against. That rung is the first such measurement and is scored as the pre-registered gate.

eligibility.verdict: ELIGIBLE: the decision is disturbed and the admitted adversarial mass is not, which is the same premise the cifar_cnn flagship arm rests on. A flat ASR curve here replicates the negative; a rise refutes it.
eligibility.scope: channels only; standalone suppression at usable accuracy is the arm's own kappa=0 rung and is a separate pre-registered branch

verdict.verdict: FLAGSHIP NEGATIVE REPLICATED on a second architecture family
